facts.fact: PTI reports that the MINTTICS draft AI bill, 86 articles in nine chapters, is in public consultation and gives citizens a right to refuse automated decisions, with risk-assessment duties on AI developers and providers.
facts.system: Proposta de Lei sobre a Inteligencia Artificial

AGO.note: Nothing on a government body using an AI system.

facts.fact: PTI reports that the MINTTICS draft AI law, 86 articles in nine chapters covering governance, supervision and sanctions, is in public consultation.
facts.system: Proposta de Lei sobre a Inteligencia Artificial

AGO.note: Nothing on an AI tool in a public sector system.
Nothing on AI built or hosted in Angola.
Only data protection duties inside the draft AI bill; no general data protection law is stated.
The consultation is not said to be online.
The draft is said to align with a white paper on ICT and other plans, but no ICT sector policy is described.

facts.fact: PTI reports the ministry's draft AI law is in public consultation.
facts.system: Proposta de Lei sobre a Inteligencia Artificial
